analyst.summary: Intellect Design Arena just posted a genuinely strong quarter -- revenue up about 19-20% and profit up over 40% -- backed by a growing deal pipeline and industry recognition for its banking-technology platforms. The balance sheet is essentially debt-free with healthy returns on capital, and the valuation is reasonable for this growth rate. The stock has fallen sharply over the past one to two years, but that appears to reflect sentiment predating this quarter's strong results rather than a genuine business problem, so we would hold rather than sell.
